functions.name: SetScalarParameterValue
functions.signature: SetScalarParameterValue(World Context Object, Collection, Parameter Name, Parameter Value)
functions.docs: Sets a scalar parameter value on the material collection instance. Logs if ParameterName is invalid.

functions.name: SetVectorParameterValue
functions.signature: SetVectorParameterValue(World Context Object, Collection, Parameter Name, Parameter Value)
functions.docs: Sets a vector parameter value on the material collection instance. Logs if ParameterName is invalid.

functions.name: GetScalarParameterValue
functions.signature: GetScalarParameterValue(World Context Object, Collection, Parameter Name)
functions.docs: Gets a scalar parameter value from the material collection instance. Logs if ParameterName is invalid.

functions.name: GetVectorParameterValue
functions.signature: GetVectorParameterValue(World Context Object, Collection, Parameter Name)
functions.docs: Gets a vector parameter value from the material collection instance. Logs if ParameterName is invalid.

functions.name: CreateDynamicMaterialInstance
functions.signature: CreateDynamicMaterialInstance(World Context Object, Parent, Optional Name, Creation Flags)
